definitions: A person who restlessly moves from place to place, seeking amusement or the companionship of others.

blocks.text: Roscoe Vernon Gaddis, known professionally as Gadabout Gaddis, was an American fisherman and television presenter. Gaddis was born in Mattoon, Illinois, and was nicknamed Gadabout by a boss who said he could never find him.

The Gadabout was an American automobile from 1914 until 1916. A four-cylinder self-declared cyclecar, it had a body woven from so-called "waterproof reeds" (wicker) on a wooden frame. It has been described as "looking like a mobile wastepaper basket".
